description: Data of the design-verify render runner (references/verify.md): the gate each runtime checker rule id reports under, with the level and waiver rules/quality-gates.json gives that gate. The runner writes the gate on every finding and needs-review entry; a rule id with no row reports under unmappedGate and cannot be waived.

ruleGates.note: The one axe rule the jsdom suite cannot run: new evidence.

A needs-review entry, never a finding: axe could not decide (gradient, image, overlap; the detail says why). List it as COL-001 unverified, never count its state clean, check the painted colours by hand.
Major, not a blocker. Off in axe-core 4.13's default rule set, which the checker runs; the row holds if a later axe enables it.
Wide content scrolls or wraps inside its own box (overflow-x: auto, truncation, overflow-wrap: anywhere). Content inside an auto or scroll box is measured at that box.
Floors are the kit's --text-mono-size and --text-label-size; the fix is the kit role, never a literal size.
Fix with matching kit size variants, never spacers or margins.
Padding floor and range in references/layout.md; the full-bleed media card is already exempt.
A class no CSS rule defines: replace it with a CSS Module rule on a --space-* token, never with inline styles.
